title: Princeton senior Edward Tian releases GPTZero, an app that estimates whether text was written by AI
summary: The app scans text to estimate AI authorship, according to the Chinese Wikipedia article on ChatGPT.

title: NOLA.com reports a Louisiana sheriff's facial-recognition match led to a wrongful arrest
summary: The report describes a man arrested after a facial-recognition match that was wrong.

title: New York City education department restricts ChatGPT on school networks and devices
summary: The department cited safety and accuracy concerns, according to the Spanish Wikipedia article on ChatGPT.

title: Check Point Research reports cybercriminals are starting to use ChatGPT to write malware
summary: The security firm described forum posts in which attackers shared ChatGPT-generated malicious code.
srcName: Check Point Research (via AI Incident Database)

title: China's rules on deep synthesis services take effect, with labeling, identity-verification and output-review requirements
summary: The Cyberspace Administration of China regulations cover generative AI and deep synthesis services.

title: US EEOC draft enforcement plan signals scrutiny of AI used in recruitment and hiring
summary: The draft Strategic Enforcement Plan is the agency's first to mention AI and machine learning.

title: NIST releases the first official version of its AI Risk Management Framework and a companion playbook
summary: The voluntary framework was published in January 2023; the exact day is not stated in the source.

title: Artists file a copyright suit against Stability AI, Midjourney and DeviantArt over training on web-scraped images
summary: Plaintiffs allege the companies trained image tools on about five billion scraped images without the artists' consent.

title: Getty Images says it is suing Stability AI for copyright infringement over training data, CNN reports
summary: Getty announced a suit against the maker of Stable Diffusion over the use of its images.

title: TIME reports OpenAI used Kenyan workers paid under USD 2 an hour to label toxic content
summary: Workers hired through the contractor Sama were allegedly exposed to graphic text and images.

title: Europa Press reports DeepMind plans to release its Sparrow chatbot in 2023 as a rival to ChatGPT
summary: The report says the DeepMind chief executive said the chatbot would first appear in a private beta.

title: The Verge reports Google's January layoffs largely spared its AI team, Google Brain
summary: The State of AI newsletter says Google cut 6.4 percent of staff, hitting units such as Intrinsic, Verily and X.

title: Microsoft extends its OpenAI partnership; press reports put the investment at USD 10bn
summary: Russian Wikipedia, citing the New York Times, dates Microsoft's USD 10bn investment in OpenAI to 23 January 2023.
srcName: Russian Wikipedia: OpenAI (cites New York Times)

title: US NAIRR Task Force final report proposes a USD 2.6bn, six-year national AI research resource
summary: The task force released a roadmap for a shared research infrastructure for AI.

title: US Defense Department updates its directive on autonomy in weapon systems, mentioning AI explicitly for the first time
summary: The updated Directive 3000.09 guidance was released on 25 January 2023.
srcName: US Department of Defense (via CSET newsletter)

title: Bloomberg reports Japan and the Netherlands will join US export controls on chipmaking equipment for China
summary: Bloomberg reported that the two countries planned to join the US restrictions; no official announcement was expected soon.
